notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/313ec3e46db4b0d6f505700f3a3192a1d1e70103.png[/img]
We will be launching a Kickstarter eventually in hopes to raise more money to speed up production of the game, and ensure that it exceeds our standards for not only Pixacrea, but for the standard of monster taming games everywhere! 

If you wish to Follow our Kickstarter, and get notified the moment we go live to help us fund the game, as well as well as get exclusive items, objects, etc. at the start of your game to include Gilded Starting Pixacrea, Special Kickstarter Backer Items, and more! Then please do so by visiting:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pivetor/pixacrea-retro-style-rogue-like-video-game-and-tcg]
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pivetor/pixacrea-retro-style-rogue-like-video-game-and-tcg[/url]

notes.title: Road Map Update #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/5712a07710a7bcdbc8be2616d333674c10db491f.png[/img]

We have a new story writer [url=https://twitter.com/JuneberryChan]@Juneberry [/url]! We've finished adding all key points to the map, adding black jack, slot machines, and all other mini games to the game as well! With that we're on one of our final and main steps to finishing Pixacrea the video game!  Why would we have to mention "the video game" you may be wondering?! That's because we've also been hard at work making a collectable trading card game for everyone who may be interested!
